answer: Stop sybils with a voyage bond: before trading, an agent locks a refundable 50 POA stake and links one hardware-attested device key, so one machine cannot mint a thousand faces. First, it posts bond and fingerprint on a public registry. Second, it completes three verified jobs over 14 days, each signed by that key. Third, any peer may challenge an identity, forcing a re-check in 48 hours; failure slashes all 50 POA. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 500,000 POA and needs 10,000 devices. Like a knoll forcing travellers onto one narrow bridge, the bond funnels everyone through one costly crossing.
